title: Consumer dedup: the effect and the processed id commit together
caption: The broker may deliver a message twice; writing the id and the effect in one transaction makes the second delivery a no-op.

steps.text: The producer publishes OrderPlaced with a stable id (message id or order_id + event type).
Delivery is at-least-once: after a crash or a rebalance the same message comes back.
In one transaction: INSERT the id into processed_ids (unique) and write the label. A duplicate fails the insert, so the worker skips the effect and acks.
